name: Words of Waste
oracle_text: {1}: The next time you would draw a card this turn, each opponent discards a card instead.
flavor_text:
"Terror corrupts order and paralyzes instinct."
—*Volume III, The Book of Decay*

name: Tomorrow, Azami's Familiar
oracle_text: If you would draw a card, look at the top three cards of your library instead. Put one of those cards into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

name: Words of Wind
oracle_text: {1}: The next time you would draw a card this turn, each player returns a permanent they control to its owner's hand instead.
flavor_text:
"Be logical in all things. Do not allow instinct or passion to cloud your mind."
—*Volume II, The Book of Insight*

name: Thought Reflection
oracle_text: If you would draw a card, draw two cards instead.
flavor_text: Only when two oracles speak in unison is an omen accepted as truth.

name: Pursuit of Knowledge
oracle_text:
If you would draw a card, you may put a study counter on this enchantment instead.
Remove three study counters from this enchantment, Sacrifice this enchantment: Draw seven cards.

name: Words of Wilding
oracle_text: {1}: The next time you would draw a card this turn, create a 2/2 green Bear creature token instead.
flavor_text:
"Instinct is undaunted by terror, unchained by logic. It is the path from which all other paths diverge."
—*Volume V, The Book of Life*

name: Eruth, Tormented Prophet
oracle_text: If you would draw a card, exile the top two cards of your library instead. You may play those cards this turn.
flavor_text: She is cursed with visions of monsters and suffering . . . and all her visions come true.

name: Laboratory Maniac
oracle_text: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, you win the game instead.
flavor_text: His mind whirled with grand plans, never thinking of what might happen if he were to succeed.

name: Blood Scrivener
oracle_text: If you would draw a card while you have no cards in hand, instead you draw two cards and you lose 1 life.
flavor_text: Make sure you bleed the fine print.

name: Plagiarize
oracle_text: Until end of turn, if target player would draw a card, instead that player skips that draw and you draw a card.

name: Bard, King of Dale
oracle_text:
Reach, vigilance
If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.
If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.

name: Alhammarret's Archive
oracle_text:
If you would gain life, you gain twice that much life instead.
If you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of your draw steps, draw two cards instead.
flavor_text: It contains the totality of Alhammarret's notes, theories, and ponderings.

name: Sages of the Anima
oracle_text: If you would draw a card, instead reveal the top three cards of your library. Put all creature cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
flavor_text: Godtrackers found new pantheons of beast-gods beyond Naya's borders.

name: Underrealm Lich
oracle_text:
If you would draw a card, instead look at the top three cards of your library, then put one into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
Pay 4 life: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.

name: Words of Worship
oracle_text: {1}: The next time you would draw a card this turn, you gain 5 life instead.
flavor_text:
"The faithful don't succumb to terror, nor are they ruled by passion. They adhere to order, for order is life."
—*Volume I, The Book of Faith*

name: Notion Thief
oracle_text:
Flash
If an opponent would draw a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, instead that player skips that draw and you draw a card.

name: Obstinate Familiar
oracle_text: If you would draw a card, you may skip that draw instead.
flavor_text:
"Lizards make excellent familiars. They never know when they've lost."
—Matoc, lavamancer
